title: Quenched Garlic Russian Chicken Dumplings
description: Snappy Russian dumplings filled with chicken, rest-meat and a garlicky flavor, served in a low-glycemic-friendly fondue pot.
instructions: Combine flour, eggs, water, salt and black pepper in a bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of the chicken and rest-meat mixture in the center of each circle and fold the dough over to form a dumpling.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the fondue pot and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot, with the remaining butter and garlic sauce on the side.
